preconditions.expression: len(time_str) == 5 and time_str[2] == ':' and time_str[:2].isdigit() and time_str[3:].isdigit() and 0 <= int(time_str[:2]) <= 23 and 0 <= int(time_str[3:]) <= 59
preconditions.description: The input string is a valid 24-hour time in 'HH:MM' format, where HH is 00–23 and MM is 00–59.

postconditions.description: The result is a non-negative integer representing the minutes until the next bus (or until midnight if no bus is available).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= (int(time_str[:2]) * 60 + int(time_str[3:]) + return_value) % 900 <= 14 for _ in range(1))
postconditions.description: If the next bus is available, the result is the exact minutes until the next bus departure (every 15 minutes starting at 06:00, ending at 00:00).

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 if (int(time_str[:2]) * 60 + int(time_str[3:]) + return_value) % 900 == 0 else True
postconditions.description: If the current time is exactly on a bus departure time, the result is 0 (no waiting time).
For times after 00:00, the result is the minutes until midnight (00:00), as no buses run after that.
